blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House prosecution panel member and Manila Rep. Joel Chua is hoping that the Senate impeachment court will be able to rule on Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s case by late November or early December now that only the alleged unexplained wealth article remains. Chua said prosecutors narrowed the case partly because they expected the defense to stretch its presentation into the following year. “Inaasahan po namin na patatagalin po nila ang article,” Chua told the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City.
